# cc-sync architecture contract v1

Source: coordinator synthesis of mapping lanes claude-native-storage + consumer-reference (Run wf_60d8895a-f7f; reports /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/mapping/claude.md and reference-consumers--coo.md), bound to the sibling contracts: synckit cc-notes doc 6c3cec2 (/Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/mapping/synckit-contract.md), reposync doc f413e56 (reposync-contract.md), Orca doc a8da144 (orca-contract.md). Approved requirements: doc 7c9a89b. Repo: github.com/yasyf/cc-sync at /Users/yasyf/Code/cc-sync (Go 1.26; scaffolded by repo-bootstrap).

## 1. Package layout
- `cmd/cc-sync` → `internal/cli.Execute(version)`
- `internal/paths` — ToolName "cc-sync", `CC_SYNC_CONFIG_DIR` override, `hostregistry.Config{Name:"cc-sync"}` dir (~/.config/cc-sync): StampDir `<Dir>/stamp` (the ONLY synckit WatchDir), CatalogPath `<Dir>/catalog-v1.json`(+lock), LedgerPath `<Dir>/transfer-v1.json`(+lock), CodeStore `<Dir>/reposync` (reposync worktree.Store root), CodeIndex `<Dir>/codesnap`, ReplicaRoot `<Dir>/replicas` (never under ~/.claude/projects until pickup), CheckoutRoot default `~/.cc-sync/checkouts`, JournalDir `<Dir>/journal`.
- `internal/claudenative` — layout + encoding + liveness + inventory (claude.md contract; ProjectDirName = Claude's Jx with UTF-16 code units and the >200 Java-hash suffix; DefaultLayout canonical ~/.claude, refuses a cc-pool projection dir; LiveSessions from `<config>/sessions/*.json` (never `*.key`) with procStart fencing + process scan; ClassifyRecord; incremental Scan with cursors: stat projects/*/*.jsonl, parse only bytes past each cursor, tail history.jsonl; Duplicates reported; never recurses into repos).
- `internal/sessionarchive` — freeze each JSONL at its last '\n' (complete records only; DroppedTailBytes recorded), archive the whole `<sid>/` tree (subagents incl. workflows, tool-results, workflows/*.json + scripts), file-history/<sid>/, task lists referenced by the session (or listId == sid), plans referenced by attachments, paste-cache blobs referenced by history.jsonl for the sid, scratchpad `/private/tmp/claude-<uid>/<Jx(cwd)>/<sid>/`. Exclude machine auth/locks/session registry (`sessions/`, `*.key`, `*.lock`, credentials, session-env, shell-snapshots, statsig). Every file is `store.Put(io.LimitReader(f, completeSize), media)` into the synckit artifact store (fixed 1 MiB chunking gives append-only prefix reuse for free); the session Manifest (JSON) is itself Put as media `cc-sync.session-manifest` and its Ref goes in the checkpoint. Completeness lists referenced-but-absent items; a session with Missing is still archived but the checkpoint reports it (never "complete").
- `internal/sessionrestore` — the fixture-tested restore adapter (claude.md relocation rules), consuming the native-fixtures lane's empirical findings (cc-notes doc to be written by that lane). "Version-tested" means observed fixtures, NOT a patch-version whitelist (root review 2026-09-26T20:01:01Z): there is no TestedVersions gate and no rejection of a newer Claude patch absent evidence. Gate only concrete, detected incompatibilities: (a) launch capability probes against the destination binary (`claude --help`/`--version` parsed once per pickup: `--resume` present; any extra flag the adapter needs, e.g. `--system-prompt-snapshot`, is used only when advertised, otherwise the documented fallback applies); (b) storage-format probes (project-dir encoding verified against the destination's existing projects dirs when any exist; required record shapes present in the source transcript); (c) source transcripts written by an older Claude are resumed by the newer destination CLI as-is (forward compatibility is Claude's), and unknown record types are copied verbatim with any unrelocated absolute paths reported in the recovery report rather than refused. Refuse only with a typed `*IncompatibleError{Capability, Detail}` naming the concrete missing capability/format. If fixtures demonstrate that a native rewrite is genuinely unportable across versions, the lane stops and escalates that concrete limitation (never silently adds exact-version gating). Relocates typed machine paths only; historical conversation text is byte-verbatim. Appends a `relocated` record when the cwd changes.
  Session identity is preserved (approved: pickup resumes the SAME session id). Local native copy with the same id: identical to, or a strict prefix of, the picked checkpoint and not live → fast-forward in place (same id). Divergent local copy (it holds records the picked checkpoint lacks) → never silently rekeyed, merged or overwritten: the default refuses with a typed `*DivergentLocalError{SessionID, LocalPath, LocalLeafUUID, LocalLastActivity, PickedLeafUUID, PickedCapturedAt}` reported in the pickup output (JSON code `divergent-local-copy`) while both histories stay separate (the picked replica remains under ReplicaRoot, the local copy untouched). Explicit intent resolves it: `--on-divergence=keep-local` (resume the existing local history, still restore code/Orca), `--on-divergence=replace` (move the local copy aside intact to `<Dir>/displaced/<sid>/<RFC3339>/` with all sidecars, then install the picked history under the same id), or `--on-divergence=fork` (install the picked history under a new UUID, reported as a fork; the only path that changes an id). Live-local collision → ErrLiveLocal (refuse; no override). Journaled staged apply under `<config>/.cc-sync-staging/<nonce>`, JSONL renamed last; crash rolls back. Resume argv/flags come from the fixtures lane (whether `--system-prompt-snapshot off` and/or rewriting the snapshot record is required so Claude re-renders the environment for the destination cwd); Orca-launched resumes use plain host-default `claude --resume <id>`, so the adapter must make the plain form correct on its own if at all possible.
- `internal/codesnap` — adapter between reposync `worktree.ArtifactSink/ArtifactSource` (raw sha256 refs + Media) and the synckit artifact store: Put streams into `store.Put` while hashing raw sha256; a durable index `<CodeIndex>/<aa>/<rawdigest>.json` maps raw digest → synckit Ref. Each code capture also Puts a "code manifest" blob `{snapshot: worktree.ArtifactRef, entries: {rawdigest: synckitRef}}` (media `cc-sync.code-manifest`) whose PutGroup deps are every synckit ref of the snapshot's Artifacts() closure; on the receiver the adapter builds ArtifactSource from that manifest (reading via the store).
- `internal/orcabridge` — `orca` CLI adapter per Orca contract: resolve binary by absolute path (/usr/local/bin/orca or PATH), env scrub (ORCA_ENVIRONMENT, ORCA_PAIRING_CODE, ORCA_REMOTE_PAIRING), never remote flags, verify `orca status --json` local target + capability + `orca recovery describe --json` executionHostId 'local' & runtimeId match before import/export; Export(worktreePath) → descriptor bytes; Import(descriptor, checkout, checkpointID, pathMap, resume, preferClient) → result; Resume; List; Activity (`orca recovery activity --json`). Orca absent/not running/capability missing → typed Unavailable (capture proceeds without layout; pickup proceeds CLI-only).
- `internal/catalog` — durable catalog (flock + durable), per-origin blocks with revision fence, per-worktree checkpoint lists with tiers (latest + hourly for 24 h + daily for 7 d), ExpiresAt = source activity + 7 d (copied verbatim by relays, so relay never renews), tombstones (small {id, revision, deleted_at, expires_at}) kept past expiry to prevent resurrection, per-checkpoint local readiness {ready, missing[], deferred}. Stamp publisher bumps `<StampDir>/generation` at most once per 10 s only when the exported catalog digest changes.
- `internal/consumer` — `syncservice.ArtifactConsumer` (Capabilities = ArtifactCapabilities("cc-sync"); List returns exactly one WatchItem {ID:"checkpoints", WatchDirs:[StampDir], Fingerprint: contents of the stamp generation file}; Reconcile runs retention/expiry GC + pins, never captures; ExportArtifacts serializes the catalog of LOCALLY READY checkpoints (own + relayed origins) as a ChangeSnapshot with roots = deterministic priority-ordered list of every checkpoint root group Ref (human-active latest first), ≤ 4096 roots; ApplyArtifacts decodes, fences per origin (revision + tombstones), re-derives roots from the payload and refuses if ≠ change.Artifacts (R2), marks a checkpoint ready only if its root is in `ready` AND codesnap Verify (reposync worktree.Verify via the store, FetchOrigin only when netpolicy allows bulk) is Ready; returns AckedRevision == source only when every checkpoint in the change is ready, else Partial with the prior receipt). Pins: owner "cc-sync/catalog" = roots of all retained checkpoints; GC via store.GC.
- `internal/scheduler` — tiers per session: human input/focus ≤ 15 m → every 2 m; autonomous activity ≤ 15 m → 5 m; any activity ≤ 1 h → 15 m; else 1 h. Capture unit = worktree (reposync `worktree.Worktree` located from each session cwd via `worktree.Locate`); a worktree's cadence = most urgent of its sessions; priority human > autonomous > recent > idle, then newest human activity. Max 2 capture workers, ≤ 1 per repo (common dir). Metadata scan every 30 s (claudenative.Scan incremental + Orca activity every 60 s when available + worktree HEAD/index mtimes) — no recursive watches, no Claude hooks installed (decision: do not mutate the user's Claude settings). Unchanged metadata stamp ⇒ no capture ⇒ zero payload. Local capture continues while the network is paused. Kick(sessionIDs) for `cc-sync sync`.
- `internal/capture` — one worktree capture: reposync `Store.Capture` (DeferredError/ErrBusy/PartialError/MissingLFSError → keep prior checkpoint, record the named reason), sessionarchive for each session in the worktree, orcabridge.Export for the descriptor (if unavailable keep the last descriptor with its age), then PutGroup(root: code manifest ref + orca descriptor ref + session manifest refs) = checkpoint root; publish to catalog; bump stamp.
- `internal/resident` — helperruntime wiring (Prepare: dirs, stamp, artifact.Open(ServiceRoot("cc-sync")), catalog, reposync store, netpolicy.NewMonitor, scheduler.Run, RegisterArtifactConsumer, helper methods `ccsync.status.v1`, `ccsync.kick.v1`, `ccsync.pin.v1` {owner, roots} for pickup; Drain stops scheduler; Close closes stores).
- `internal/pickup` — CLI-process orchestration: select item/checkpoint (must be locally ready), refuse live-local collisions for sessions to resume, pin roots via `ccsync.pin.v1` (owner cc-sync/pickup/<op>), open the store with `artifact.OpenReadOnly`, reposync `Store.Restore` (Dest default `<CheckoutRoot>/<repo-relpath>/<source>-<worktree-name|branch>-<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>`, sibling reuse never rolls back and reports Newer; FetchLFS only when netpolicy allows), sessionrestore for every session in the checkpoint (all installed natively so dormant bindings are resumable), then orcabridge.Import with pathMap (source checkout → dest; source ~/.claude/projects/<enc> → dest; scratchpad) and resume = selected sessions (default: the most recent human session), `--prefer-client $CC_SYNC_ORCA_CLIENT_INSTANCE_ID`. One-command interactive pickup (root review): when stdout/stdin are a TTY and `--json` is not set and Orca did not resume the selected session (Orca unavailable, `--no-orca`, or Orca import without resume), pickup finishes restore, unpins, and then replaces itself (syscall.Exec) with native `claude --resume <sid>` in the recovered worktree for the selected session (default: most recent human session; `--resume <sid>` picks; more than one selected without Orca → refuse with a usage error naming them, since one terminal hosts one session), with no automatic work prompt. Other restored sessions stay natively resumable (`cc-sync resume <sid>` or plain `claude --resume <sid>` in that worktree). With `--json` or non-interactive stdio, pickup never execs and returns structured launch details per session: `launch: {argv, dir, env_unset, env_set}`. Cancel (SIGTERM) before Orca import removes a fresh recovery worktree; unpins at end.
- `internal/cli` — cobra tree; every command supports `--json` with `"version":1`; the exact JSON shapes for status/list/inspect/pickup (+ error envelope, exit codes 0/1/2/3/4/5, selectors, `--progress ndjson`) are defined in the Orca contract §"cc-sync CLI JSON consumed by the native picker" and are binding. Commands: install [--no-synckitd] (dirs+stamp, manifest via `synckitd register`, `synckitd install`, probe helper), uninstall [--purge], list, inspect, status (helper, scheduler, catalog, per-peer delivery.Status incl. pause reasons + local/peer network), sync [--session ...] (kick + wait), pickup (one command: restore + resume, see internal/pickup; `--on-divergence=refuse|keep-local|replace|fork`, default refuse), resume <sid> (interactive exec of claude in the restored cwd for an already-picked-up dormant session; refuses live collisions), helper-serve (hidden). The pickup JSON gains per-session `launch` details and the `divergent-local-copy` error code (additive to the Orca contract shapes; the Orca picker surfaces the collision and offers the explicit choices).

## 2. Checkpoint model
- Checkpoint = (origin host, worktree ID, captured_at): root group Ref with deps {code manifest Ref, orca descriptor Ref?, session manifest Refs...}; catalog entry carries: id (hash of root digest + origin + worktree id), tier classes, captured_at, source_activity_at, session summaries {id, title, last_activity, last_human_activity, activity class, claude_version}, repo {origin, relpath, branch, source_path}, orca {kind, name, instance_id, freshness}, code summary (reposync Summary), deferred/partial reason, completeness.
- Catalog payload stays compact (≤ 8 MiB; per-checkpoint detail lives in artifacts). Expected scale: ~40 sessions × 33 checkpoints.
- Readiness on a receiver = root closure complete in the local store AND reposync Verify Ready. `cc-sync list` shows only items whose chosen checkpoint is ready as pick-up-able; others show completeness.missing and the pause/delivery reason.
- Retention/expiry per worktree: latest + newest-per-hour for 24 h + newest-per-day for 7 d; everything expires 7 d after source activity; tombstones persist (bounded, compact).

## 3. Manifest registered with synckit
`{"name":"cc-sync","binary":"cc-sync","brew":"yasyf/tap/cc-sync","watch":{"debounce":"10s"},"service":{"kind":"resident","schema_fingerprint":"<consumer.Fingerprint>"},"helper":{"command":"helper-serve","session_type":"Aqua"}}`

## 4. Dependencies
Build against the in-flight synckit (branch cc-sync/artifact-delivery) and reposync (branch cc-sync/worktree-snapshot) through a NON-committed go.work at /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/go.work until their releases (synckit v0.40.0, reposync v0.31.0) land; then require the released versions. Until their foundations land, lanes code against narrow internal interfaces and fakes.
